tutorial.title: LOOK AROUND THE SHOP
tutorial.body: Drag the view or tap the arrow buttons to look. Tap W, A, S, or D to walk.

tutorial.title: PICK UP A TOY
tutorial.body: Aim at a loose toy, then tap ACT. The prompt shows what will happen next.

tutorial.title: MATCH THE CATEGORY
tutorial.body: Carry it to a matching display, aim at an empty spot, and tap ACT.

tutorial.title: MEND A MATCHED PAIR
tutorial.body: Find the other half, place both on one bench, then tap ACT to repair.

tutorial.title: SPEND A DISPLAY CREDIT
tutorial.body: Each restored display earns one credit. Tap TOOLS to improve this shift.

tutorial.title: CHOOSE THE ACTIVE TOY
tutorial.body: The bright trolley token is in your hands. Tap CARRY to choose another toy.
